# PSY Psykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Odense)

PSY Psykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Odense) is a psychiatric outpatient clinic in Odense, Denmark, appearing in the ADHD-databasen (ADHD database) 2024 report as one of the treatment units evaluated against national quality indicators for adult ADHD care [^src1][^src2].

The clinic is documented in connection with two separate quality indicators. For Indicator 10 — which measures the share of adult treatment courses in which a patient's need for social support was assessed within 120 days of treatment start — PSY Psykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Odense) achieved a result of 29% (with a confidence interval of 21–37%), based on 41 out of 143 treatment courses [^src1]. This is far below the national quality target of 90% for this indicator [^src1]. The broader context shows that this shortfall was not unique to Odense: nationally the fulfilment rate for Indicator 10 was only 37%, with regional results ranging from 14% to 52%, and this was the first time the indicator had been reported at all. The steering group behind the ADHD database attributed the low scores in part to registration practices and data quality issues, particularly from child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals, and resolved to work on improving registration practice going forward [^src1].

For Indicator 11 — which tracks the share of adult treatment courses in which the patient is receiving ADHD medication within 120 days of the start of a structured treatment pathway ("pakkeforløb") — the clinic's result was 38% (confidence interval 30–46%), based on 54 out of 143 treatment courses [^src2]. This indicator was also being reported for adults for the first time, following the 2024 expansion of the ADHD database to include adult patients [^src2]. Nationally, this indicator showed sharp regional variation, ranging from 85% in Region Nordjylland to just 37% in Region Hovedstaden, a gap the report attributes more likely to differences in registration practice than to genuine differences in clinical care [^src2].

Together, these two data points position PSY Psykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Odense) as a unit whose measured performance — 29% on Indicator 10 and 38% on Indicator 11 — falls well short of the 90% national development goal, situating it within a nationwide pattern of under-reporting or under-delivery on these adult ADHD quality measures rather than as an isolated outlier [^src1][^src2].
